title: Keyturn Guest Protection Plan: How the Young-Driver Loading Is Measured
content:
The young-driver surcharge on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election is the level's protection surcharge
percentage of the protection charged on the election for the daily cover of the trip, held to the ceiling on the
loading for one trip, which is 150.00 USD, and the amount is rounded half up to the cent only once the whole of it has
been worked out.

The protection charged on the election for the daily cover is the protection fee charged for the trip less any
protection fee returned against it.

| The level the election stands on | Protection surcharge percentage |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 25 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 22 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 18 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 15 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 12 |

## The order the measure is taken in

The protection fee charged for the trip is taken first and any protection fee returned against it deducted, and
the level's percentage is then taken on the figure so reached. The result is held down to 150.00 USD where it
stands above that, and only then is the whole rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election on Keyturn Standard Protection carrying 620.00 USD of protection fee charged for the trip, with
nothing returned against it, gives a base of 620.00 USD. Twenty-two percent of 620.00 USD is 136.40 USD, which
stands below 150.00 USD, so the loading is 136.40 USD.

An election on Keyturn Minimum Protection carrying 900.00 USD of protection fee charged, with 100.00 USD
returned against it, gives a base of 800.00 USD. Twenty-five percent of 800.00 USD is 200.00 USD, which stands
above 150.00 USD, so the loading is held at 150.00 USD.

An election on Keyturn Declined Protection gives 0 percent of whatever base is reached, so the loading is
0.00 USD.
